item.description:
- **Updates install themselves.** New versions download in the background and install when Colima Desktop quits — or right away with **Restart to Update** in the menu. Switch it off in Settings → Updates. - **Beta channel.** Settings → Updates → Update channel: **Beta** also offers pre-release versions. - **Light, dark or System, three times.** Settings sets the appearance of the interface, the terminal and the logs apart, so the terminal can stay dark while the rest follows macOS. - **Console fonts.** Pick the font, size and line height for the terminal and for the logs. Open windows change at once.
[All changes in 0.7 on GitHub](https://github.com/mx0r/colima-desktop/releases/tag/v0.7)

item.title: 0.7.0-beta.3
item.description:
- **Terminal and logs each get their own appearance.** Settings → Terminal and Settings → Logs each have an Appearance row (System, Light or Dark); Interface stays under Settings → Appearance. The shared setting from beta.2 carries over to both.
[All changes in 0.7.0-beta.3 on GitHub](https://github.com/mx0r/colima-desktop/releases/tag/v0.7.0-beta.3)

item.title: 0.7.0-beta.2
item.description:
- **Light, dark or System, twice.** Settings → Appearance sets the interface and the logs and terminal windows apart, so the consoles can stay dark while the rest follows macOS. - **Console fonts.** Pick the font, size and line height for the terminal and for the logs. Open windows change at once.
[All changes in 0.7.0-beta.2 on GitHub](https://github.com/mx0r/colima-desktop/releases/tag/v0.7.0-beta.2)

item.title: 0.7.0-beta.1
item.description:
- **Updates install themselves.** New versions download in the background and install when Colima Desktop quits — or right away with **Restart to Update** in the menu. Switch it off in Settings → Updates. - **Beta channel.** Settings → Updates → Update channel: **Beta** also offers pre-release versions. Choose Beta there to get the next betas automatically.
[All changes in 0.7.0-beta.1 on GitHub](https://github.com/mx0r/colima-desktop/releases/tag/v0.7.0-beta.1)
